subject: Staged onramp incentive ask — SkylineHealth pilot
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged onramp incentive ask — SkylineHealth pilot

Team,

Quick summary: SkylineHealth (prospect -> pilot) has pushed their integration timeline by ~6 weeks due to a security review in their compliance team. The delay means they will hit their original committed usage cadence two quarters later than planned. They like the product, plan to move to Dedicated once live, and are requesting some short-term commercial accommodation to keep momentum.

Ask: provisional staged incentive (time-limited rebate) to preserve list pricing and avoid renegotiation. I'm proposing a capped rebate that phases down over first 3 months post-launch. Numbers and rationale attached (staged_onramp_summary.pdf, proposed_incentive_table.xlsx).

Key constraints / notes:
- This is a one-off for a strategic health client (reference deal DL-9841).
- Impact to near-term revenue is front-loaded (we would recognize lower net in Q4 but higher retention/ARR if we keep them).
- Product gap: they need multi-model routing for a specific inference path we currently ship in the next minor release (estimated GA in ~8 weeks). The rebate is intended to bridge that timing delta.

Immediate request: Can someone advise on an acceptable commercial guardrail (cap, duration, and any milestone tie-ins) and whether we need exec-level sign-off for approval? If exec sign-off is required, I can pull together a short 1-pager for Laura.

Attachments: staged_onramp_summary.pdf (PDF) — 2 pages; proposed_incentive_table.xlsx (Excel) — simple tier table + revenue impact tab.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged onramp incentive ask — SkylineHealth pilot

Ben —

Thanks for the summary. High-level thoughts: I'm ok with a short, capped incentive for a strategic pilot as long as there's a clear ROI trigger and a hard cap that Finance can accept. Two asks before we escalate:

1) Please add a simple revenue-impact line: "expected lost revenue vs expected retained expansion" for Q4 and next two quarters. We need a $-number to show tradeoff.
2) Recommend we limit to a maximum $30k total rebate and tie payouts to the 3 product milestones (integration complete, pilot success metric, Dedicated enablement).

If the numbers come in below $30k and legal signs off on milestone language, I think Laura can approve without a full exec deck. If above $30k or we need changes to standard T&C, we'll need exec approval.

Cc'ing Karthik for suggested language on canary/rollback terms and Laura so she sees scope.

-Monica
Monica Patel
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged onramp incentive ask — SkylineHealth pilot

On Tue, Sep 15, 2026 at 11:03 AM Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben —
> 
> Thanks for the summary. High-level thoughts: I'm ok with a short, capped incentive for a strategic pilot as long as there's a clear ROI trigger and a hard cap that Finance can accept. Two asks before we escalate:
> 
> 1) Please add a simple revenue-impact line: "expected lost revenue vs expected retained expansion" for Q4 and next two quarters. We need a $-number to show tradeoff.
> 2) Recommend we limit to a maximum $30k total rebate and tie payouts to the 3 product milestones (integration complete, pilot success metric, Dedicated enablement).
> 
> If the numbers come in below $30k and legal signs off on milestone language, I think Laura can approve without a full exec deck. If above $30k or we need changes to standard T&C, we'll need exec approval.

Adding a proposed commercial structure (see attached spreadsheet). Short version: 10% rebate month 1, 7% month 2, 3% month 3 OR a $30k cap — whichever is lower. Payouts released after each milestone sign-off with a 30-day verification window.

Operational guardrail suggestions:
- Cap at $30k total (Finance friendly).
- Rebate applies only to usage associated with the pilot org id (no cross-account).
- Auto-revert to list pricing at the end of month 3 unless both sides sign an extension.
- If product milestone slips beyond 12 weeks, rebate expires and customer returns to list (we keep any rebates already issued).

I'll draft suggested language for the exec ask: short background, $-impact, ask (approval for one-off cap + milestone linkage), and a recommended signatory. Ben, can you fill the $-impact table in the same spreadsheet by EOD?

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
Attachment: proposed_incentive_table.xlsx (updated)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Alyssa Greene <alyssa@skylinehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@skylinehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staged onramp incentive ask — SkylineHealth pilot

Thanks team — good thread.

Laura here: I've reviewed the numbers Karthik attached and the $-impact Ben put into the sheet. Given the strategic fit and high likelihood of expansion to Dedicated, I'm prepared to approve a provisional incentive under these terms:

- 10% rebate on usage in month 1, 7% in month 2, 3% in month 3.
- Total rebate capped at $30,000.
- Payouts contingent on the three milestone sign-offs: (1) integration complete (integration test passed), (2) pilot metric pass (NPS >= 45 and latency SLA met for 2 weeks), (3) Dedicated enablement scheduled within 12 weeks of pilot start.
- If any milestone is not met, future rebate tranches are forfeited. Rebates already issued will not be reclaimed.
- Legal to draft a 1-page amendment; Finance confirms we can book as a billing credit if under $30k.

Ben — please provide the customer-facing one-pager and a DocuSign package for Alyssa/Procurement. Keep the language focused on milestones and cap. I'll sign once Legal adds the standard milestone clause.

Alyssa — thanks for your patience. If this looks broadly acceptable, we'll send the 1-pager and DocuSign link later today.

Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
Redwood Inference
